cite.text: BioStem Technologies, Inc. · S-1 filed Oct 2, 2026 · Six months ended Jun 30, 2026

analysis: Revenue was $14.0M in H1 2026, down 48% year over year.

Gross margin was 61.3%, down 33.0 points from H1 2025. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $17.3M, an operating margin of -123.2%. Operating expenses grew 29% against revenue growth of -48%. The fastest-growing cost line was Other operating costs (+972%). The period ended with a net loss of $17.8M.

Operating cash flow was −$6.4M. Non-cash charges added back $1.2M of depreciation and amortization and $3.9M of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items added $6.3M. Capital expenditures of $58K exceeded it, leaving free cash flow of −$6.4M.
